From fea3fdf975dd9f3e5248afaab8fe023db313f005 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jiasheng Jiang <jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2021 09:41:26 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/ast: potential dereference of null pointer

The return value of kzalloc() needs to be checked.
To avoid use of null pointer '&ast_state->base' in case of the
failure of alloc.

Fixes: f0adbc382b8b ("drm/ast: Allocate initial CRTC state of the correct size")
Signed-off-by: Jiasheng Jiang <jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Zimmermann <tzimmermann@suse.de>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20211214014126.2211535-1-jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c
index 1e30eaeb0e1b..d5c98f79d58d 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c
@@ -1121,7 +1121,10 @@ static void ast_crtc_reset(struct drm_crtc *crtc)
 	if (crtc->state)
 		crtc->funcs->atomic_destroy_state(crtc, crtc->state);
 
-	__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	if (ast_state)
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	else
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
 }
 
 static struct drm_crtc_state *
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c`**
   - The code within the `ast_crtc_reset` function was modified to include a null pointer check for `ast_state` before dereferencing it.
   - The line that previously called `__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);` was changed to:
     ```c
     if (ast_state)
         __drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
     else
         __drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
     ```
   - This ensures that if `ast_state` is null, the function will not attempt to dereference it, thus preventing a potential null pointer dereference.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `ast_mode.c` directly addresses a potential bug related to dereferencing a null pointer. By adding a conditional check for `ast_state`, the patch ensures that the function behaves correctly even if memory allocation for `ast_state` fails (i.e., if `kzalloc()` returns null). This change is a defensive programming measure that enhances the robustness of the code by preventing runtime errors associated with null pointer dereferences.

Here is the root cause:
The bug arises from the lack of a null pointer check after the allocation of memory for `ast_state` using `kzalloc()`. If the memory allocation fails, `ast_state` will be null, and dereferencing it in the function `__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);` would lead to a null pointer dereference, causing a potential crash or undefined behavior.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void ast_crtc_reset(struct drm_crtc *crtc)
 {
 	struct ast_crtc_state *ast_state =
 		kzalloc(sizeof(*ast_state), GFP_KERNEL);
 
 	if (crtc->state)
 		crtc->funcs->atomic_destroy_state(crtc, crtc->state);
 
-	__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	if (ast_state)
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	else
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
 }

Root cause:
The bug arises from the lack of a null pointer check after the allocation of memory for `ast_state` using `kzalloc()`. If the memory allocation fails, `ast_state` will be null, and dereferencing it in the function `__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);` would lead to a null pointer dereference, causing a potential crash or undefined behavior.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
struct ast_crtc_state *ast_state = kzalloc(sizeof(*ast_state), GFP_KERNEL);
__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because there is no check to see if `ast_state` is null after the call to `kzalloc()`. If memory allocation fails, `ast_state` will be null, and dereferencing `&ast_state->base` will lead to a null pointer dereference, causing a potential crash or undefined behavior.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (ast_state)
    __drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
else
    __drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
```
Reason:
The fix introduces a null pointer check for `ast_state` before dereferencing it. If `ast_state` is null, it safely calls `__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);`, preventing a null pointer dereference and thus avoiding a potential crash or undefined behavior.
